metadata.title: TensorBoard AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from TensorBoard Governance Benchmark

components.title: TensorBoard
components.description: AI/ML component for TensorBoard with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure baseline quality metrics are logged for every experiment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard scalar summaries to log baseline model-quality metrics for each training and evaluation run so regressions are visible before promotion.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Log evaluation metrics as TensorBoard scalars for each run and compare candidate runs against the approved baseline across the same benchmark dataset.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is suited to logging, visualizing, and comparing experiment metrics rather than directly changing model behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dataset provenance metadata is captured as experiment artifacts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log dataset version, source, split definition, collection date, preprocessing version, and ownership metadata alongside TensorBoard runs for auditability.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required provenance fields / total required provenance fields for each experiment.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure provenance documentation completeness is 100% before model promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard does not own governance workflows, but it can store linked metadata and artifacts that support provenance review.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure contamination and split-integrity checks are logged before training acceptance

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log overlap, duplication, and contamination validation results so problematic training datasets are visible in TensorBoard before model comparison or release review.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Duplicate rate, train-test overlap rate, contamination rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute overlap and contamination statistics during data validation and log them as scalars or text summaries before training begins.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure train-test overlap and contamination rates remain below threshold before training results are considered valid.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is an observability and evidence rule rather than a Hugging Face-aligned model-card metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure subgroup representation metrics are logged for training and evaluation datasets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track coverage statistics and subgroup sample proportions in TensorBoard so underrepresentation trends are visible during experiment review.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, class imbalance ratio, subgroup sample proportion

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Calculate subgroup proportions and coverage gaps over training and evaluation datasets; log them as scalars or tables for each run.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds for the intended use case.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of target representation

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can make representativeness evidence visible, even though it does not enforce dataset acceptance policies.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure training and validation curves are logged and compared for instability

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard scalar charts to monitor loss, accuracy, and validation divergence so overfitting or unstable convergence patterns are detected early.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Train-validation loss gap, variance across epochs

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute and visualize the difference between training and validation loss or accuracy across epochs; flag sustained divergence trends.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure train-validation divergence remains below threshold for accepted models.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is directly designed for this form of model-development observability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure privacy-risk evaluation metrics are logged for prompt and response datasets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard to visualize privacy-focused evaluation scores so prompt or output PII exposure trends are visible across model versions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, PII precision, PII recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run privacy evaluations using seeded PII datasets; leakage rate = leaked PII instances / total seeded PII instances. Log precision and recall for privacy detectors.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy detection recall remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can expose privacy risk measurements but is not a runtime masking or redaction layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure confidential-content exposure tests are logged for release review

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record confidential-data leakage evaluations in TensorBoard so model or prompt changes with worsening exposure risk are visible before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = confidential entities disclosed in prompt or output evaluations / total seeded confidential entities in the approved test set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure confidential leakage rate remains below threshold before production promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a measurement-and-evidence control, not direct prevention.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure membership-inference attack success is benchmarked and trended

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log adversarial privacy evaluation results so membership-inference risk can be compared across experiments and model versions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = correct membership disclosures / total adversarial membership-inference prompts in the controlled evaluation suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure membership-inference success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is useful for comparing privacy risk trends over time across runs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure prompt-injection evaluation scores are logged for each tested model or prompt version

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard scalars and text summaries to track prompt-injection test outcomes and compare attack success across release candidates.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs caused by direct injection prompts / total prompt-injection test cases.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold for approved release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard provides observability into attack testing results rather than runtime enforcement.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure indirect prompt-injection scenarios are benchmarked with external context variations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track evaluations with malicious retrieved content or external instructions so indirect-attack susceptibility is visible in TensorBoard comparisons.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs caused by malicious external content / total indirect-injection test cases.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure indirect prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant where TensorBoard is used to inspect evaluation runs for RAG or agent-like systems.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hidden-prompt disclosure evaluations are visible in experiment dashboards

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log prompt-leak test outcomes so any increase in disclosure risk across models, prompts, or releases can be reviewed during experiment comparison.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = successful prompt leaks / total prompt-leak attempts in the controlled evaluation suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure hidden-prompt disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can surface disclosure test results and trend them over time.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure jailbreak success and refusal rates are logged for all release candidates

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track jailbreak benchmark results in TensorBoard to compare how often models or prompts fail to refuse disallowed requests.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Jailbreak success rate, refusal compliance rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Jailbreak success = disallowed completions / total jailbreak attempts; refusal compliance = compliant refusals / total disallowed requests.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Attack success rate, safety refusal rate

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure jailbreak success rate remains below threshold and refusal compliance remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard's value here is run comparison and anomaly visibility.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness scores are logged per model and benchmark set

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard to visualize hallucination rate and faithfulness scores across experiments so unsupported-claim regressions are visible.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is suited to plotting and comparing these evaluation results, even if separate evaluators compute them.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity scoring is logged and trended across experiments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard scalar summaries to monitor toxicity scores and threshold exceedance rates so harmful-generation regressions are easy to spot.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score evaluation outputs with a toxicity classifier; log average toxicity and percentage of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxicity exceedance rate remain below approved limits.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a natural TensorBoard use case because it is fundamentally a metric-visualization platform.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure harmful-output violation trends are visible in release dashboards

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log safety benchmark outcomes and harmful-content policy violations so unsafe-output regressions are visible during review.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Violation rate = policy-violating outputs / total harm-focused evaluation prompts or monitored samples.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Safety benchmark score, refusal rate, toxicity score

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure harmful-output violation rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard helps teams see the trend but does not itself block harmful outputs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure conversational or session-level toxicity trends are visualized

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Aggregate conversation-level safety results and log them so teams can detect whether multi-turn interactions create more toxic outcomes than single-turn tests.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Toxic-conversation rate = unsafe conversations / total evaluated conversations over the conversational benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure toxic-conversation rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can visualize aggregated session metrics as scalars or custom dashboards.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness and subgroup disparity metrics are logged per experiment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard to compare output quality or harmfulness across demographic slices so bias trends are visible before release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup toxicity disparity, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute benchmark scores or group disparities across protected-group slices and store them as experiment metrics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure demographic disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores remain within approved bounds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is appropriate for visual comparison of fairness metrics over many runs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure source-grounding and citation quality metrics are logged for retrieval-based systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log citation accuracy and groundedness scores so source attribution quality can be reviewed alongside other evaluation metrics.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Citation accuracy = answers with correct supporting citations / total citation-required answers; groundedness = supported claims / total claims.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure citation accuracy and groundedness remain above threshold for approved releases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is best used as the reporting surface for these evaluations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure run metadata and experiment comparisons are retained for traceability

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Store run IDs, model versions, hyperparameters, evaluation artifacts, and comparison views so each result can be traced back to the generating experiment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = runs with required traceability fields and linked evaluation artifacts / total reviewed runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure run traceability completeness remains at 100% for promoted experiments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard supports experiment traceability at the run level, though not full workflow governance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure gradient and parameter-distribution summaries are monitored

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard histograms and distributions to visualize gradients, weights, and activations so exploding or vanishing gradient issues are visible during training.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Gradient norm, weight distribution drift, activation saturation

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Log histogram summaries or scalar norms for gradients and parameters by layer over training steps and compare against stable reference runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure gradient norms and parameter distributions remain within approved training-stability thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is one of TensorBoard's most native capabilities because histograms and distributions are core visualizations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure profiling data is collected for representative training runs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard profiling views to inspect bottlenecks in CPU, GPU, input pipeline, and memory behavior for representative model-training jobs.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Step time, input-pipeline utilization, memory usage, device utilization

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Collect profiler traces and summarize utilization, bottleneck percentages, and memory trends over representative workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure representative training runs meet approved utilization and step-time thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Official TensorBoard integrations explicitly support sampled profiling and performance analysis.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure embedding projections are visualized for representative classes or clusters

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard's embedding projector to inspect whether learned representations separate expected classes or collapse undesirably.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Project embeddings into lower-dimensional space and compute cluster purity or separation on labeled validation subsets.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure representative embedding clusters maintain acceptable separation and purity thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard's embedding projector is directly relevant for this form of interpretability evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hyperparameter changes are logged and compared across runs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use TensorBoard HParams views to track hyperparameter settings and compare their effect on quality, fairness, privacy, and safety metrics.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = runs with complete hyperparameter logging / total reviewed runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure complete hyperparameter logging exists for all experiments considered for promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard's HParams support makes this especially relevant for controlled model-development review.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim metrics are visible in experiment dashboards

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log unsupported-claim rate and factuality scores so truthfulness regressions can be compared across runs and model variants.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from configured evaluator over the benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard is suitable for tracking these values over time even if computation comes from external evaluators.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure output consistency benchmarks are logged across repeated test runs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track repeated evaluation results so unstable responses or large variance across identical inputs are visible in experiment comparisons.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Consistency = stable equivalent outputs / total repeated test cases; variance score derived from semantic distance across repeated responses.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure response consistency remains above threshold and output variance remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard supports this as a comparative evaluation dashboard use case.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure latency and throughput metrics are logged for representative inference workloads

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track inference latency, throughput, and resource consumption so performance regressions are visible during model and system comparison.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Log latency and throughput as scalars over benchmark or production-like workloads and compare candidate runs against the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency and throughput remain within approved thresholds relative to baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can visualize these metrics but does not manage serving or routing directly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure evaluation dashboards cover quality, safety, privacy, fairness, and robustness domains

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build TensorBoard dashboards that aggregate metrics across required risk domains instead of reviewing only loss or accuracy.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated risk domains with active logged evaluation metrics / total mandated risk domains in the benchmark standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on model-card and benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure logged risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across required evaluation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This matches TensorBoard's role as an evidence aggregation and visualization surface.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployed models have linked model-card and limitation documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach model-card references, intended use, known limitations, license, and baseline metrics to experiment outputs so reviewers can access model transparency evidence.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each reviewed model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness is 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can expose or link this evidence but does not replace a model registry or policy engine.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure system-level architecture and dependency evidence is linked to experiments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the system boundary, dependencies, data sources, evaluation tools, and runtime assumptions in artifacts associated with TensorBoard runs.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required architecture and dependency fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness is 100% before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorBoard can serve as the review surface for linked artifacts, but this remains partly manual governance work.
